text:
Predicates:
Allowed(x, y) ::: x is allowed to move in with y.
ManagedBuilding(x) ::: x is a managed building.
DepositRequired(x) ::: a deposit is required to rent an apartment in x.
SecurityDeposit(x, y) ::: the security deposit at x is y.
MonthlyRent(x, y) ::: the monthly rent at x is y.
MoreThan(x, y) ::: x is more than y.
Pet(x) ::: x is a pet.
Cat(x) ::: x is a cat.
Fluffy ::: Fluffy.
Tom ::: Tom.
Rent(x, y) ::: x rents an apartment in y.
MoveInAllowed(x, y) ::: x is allowed to move in with y.
Question:
Allowed(Tom, Fluffy) ∧ Rent(Tom, oliveGarden) ::: Tom is allowed to move into an apartment in The Olive Garden with Fluffy.

Premises:
∃x (ManagedBuilding(x) ∧ Allowed(x, pet)) ::: Pets are allowed in some managed buildings.
∀x (ManagedBuilding(x) → DepositRequired(x)) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in a managed building.
∀x ∀y ((SecurityDeposit(x, y) → (y = MonthlyRent(x) ∨ MoreThan(y, MonthlyRent(x))))) ::: The security deposit can be either equal to the monthly rent at a managed building or more.
Cat(fluffy) ∧ Pet(fluffy) ∧ Fluffy = fluffy ::: Fluffy is Tom's cat. Cats are pets.
ManagedBuilding(oliveGarden) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building.
MonthlyRent(oliveGarden, 2000) ::: The monthly rent at the Olive Garden is $2000.
MoreThan(2000, 1500) ::: $2000 is more than $1500.
(Rent(Tom, x) ∧ Allowed(Tom, fluffy) ∧ SecurityDeposit(x, y) ∧ ¬MoreThan(y, 1500)) → Rent(Tom, x) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in a managed building if he is allowed to move in with Fluffy, and the security deposit is no more than $1500.
∀x (ManagedBuilding(x) ∧ Allowed(x, pet) → Allowed(x, pet)) ::: If a managed building allows pets, then people are allowed to move in with a pet.

Conclusion:
Allowed(Tom, Fluffy) ∧ Rent(Tom, oliveGarden) ::: Tom is allowed to move into an apartment in The Olive Garden with Fluffy.
